details.description: Voxtral Realtime is Mistral AI's speech-to-text model built for live, streaming transcription, released February 4, 2026 as the streaming counterpart to the batch-oriented Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2. It is a 4-billion-parameter model that Mistral says runs efficiently enough for edge deployment, with transcription delay configurable from sub-200ms (for voice agents) up to about 2.4 seconds (for subtitling). Mistral's own model card lists 'voxtral-mini-realtime-latest' as the alias that currently resolves to the dated release 'voxtral-mini-transcribe-realtime-2602'.
advantages: Mistral reports transcription support in 13 languages: English, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic, French, Portuguese, Russian, German, Japanese, Korean, Italian, and Dutch (Mistral AI, "Voxtral transcribes at the speed of sound").
Delay is configurable down to sub-200ms for latency-sensitive applications such as voice agents (Mistral AI, "Voxtral transcribes at the speed of sound").
Mistral reports the model stays within 1-2% word error rate when run at a 480ms delay setting (Mistral AI, "Voxtral transcribes at the speed of sound").
Runs on a 4-billion-parameter footprint that Mistral describes as efficient enough for edge deployment (Mistral AI, "Voxtral transcribes at the speed of sound").
Released as open weights under the Apache 2.0 license on Hugging Face (Mistral AI, "Voxtral transcribes at the speed of sound").
disadvantages: Mistral's own audio capabilities documentation states real-time transcription is not compatible with the `diarize` (speaker-labeling) parameter (Mistral AI Capabilities: Audio).
Documented for 13 languages, a defined list rather than broad open-ended coverage (Mistral AI, "Voxtral transcribes at the speed of sound").
use_cases: Live, streaming voice transcription for voice agents and contact-center automation
Real-time subtitling or captioning when run at a higher-latency setting
Edge or on-device deployment for latency- or privacy-sensitive live transcription
Feeding a live transcript into an LLM as part of a voice-to-voice pipeline

notes: '-latest' alias: the model doc page (docs.mistral.ai/models/voxtral-mini-transcribe-realtime-26-02) lists the dated id 'voxtral-mini-transcribe-realtime-2602' together with the alias 'voxtral-mini-realtime-latest' -- Mistral's own page drops 'transcribe' from that alias, so it does not literally match this catalog entry's slug/uri 'voxtral-mini-transcribe-realtime-latest'; corrected the description to quote the alias as it actually appears on the model card. Diarization conflict: Mistral's launch blog (voxtral-transcribe-2) states 'Both models provide speaker labels with precise timing' for the Transcribe V2 + Realtime family, but the current docs.mistral.ai audio capabilities page explicitly states 'Realtime transcription is not compatible with the diarize parameter' -- kept the docs page's statement (current reference doc) as the disadvantage and flagged the discrepancy here rather than picking one silently. Word-error-rate figures are cited in advantages per the brief (WER is not an eligible 0-100 accuracy metric for the evaluations list), so evaluations is empty. Catalog facts give no max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens for this model and none were found on the maker's pages either, so none were added.
